recommended_action: Designate ONE primary 'wooden speaker cabinet manufacturer' page; differentiate siblings by a single clear modifier (use-case: hifi / oem / empty-box / enclosure) with distinct H1 angle + internal cross-links so each ranks for its own modifier rather than competing for the bare head term.
